faqs.q: How does SecuEdge help maintain attorney-client privilege?
faqs.a: SecuEdge's solutions implement multiple technical controls designed specifically to protect attorney-client communications and work product. These include end-to-end encryption for all communications, secure document storage with granular access controls, and audit trails to demonstrate the maintenance of confidentiality. Our solutions also include specific controls to prevent inadvertent sharing of privileged information.

faqs.q: Can SecuEdge help implement ethical walls between practice groups?
faqs.a: Yes, SecuEdge specializes in implementing robust ethical wall systems for law firms. Our matter-based security controls allow for precise separation between practice groups, attorneys, and matters to prevent conflicts of interest. The system can be configured to align with your firm's specific conflict policies and includes automated enforcement of access restrictions based on client, matter, and attorney relationships.

faqs.q: How does SecuEdge handle regulatory compliance for legal organizations?
faqs.a: Our security platform includes specialized compliance modules for legal-specific regulations including bar association requirements, GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA (for healthcare clients), GLBA (for financial clients), and international data protection laws. The system provides automated compliance reporting, control verification, and regulatory update monitoring to ensure your firm stays current with evolving requirements across all jurisdictions where you operate.

faqs.q: How can SecuEdge secure our eDiscovery process?
faqs.a: SecuEdge provides comprehensive security for the eDiscovery lifecycle. This includes secure collection tools with chain of custody management, encrypted transfer mechanisms, secure review platforms with granular access controls, and protected production workflows. Our solutions integrate with major eDiscovery platforms while adding additional security layers specifically designed to protect sensitive discovery materials from unauthorized access or tampering.

faqs.q: How does SecuEdge protect against targeted attacks against law firms?
faqs.a: SecuEdge utilizes legal-specific threat intelligence to identify and block attacks specifically targeting legal organizations. Our advanced threat protection includes specialized phishing defenses for legal-themed attacks, monitoring for nation-state threat actors known to target legal organizations, and behavior-based detection systems trained to identify anomalous activity in legal-specific workflows and systems.
